problem.h2: By the time a deal is in the news, it's already crowded.
problem.body: Private markets reward whoever sees first. Most databases update quarterly and stop at the US and Europe. We track companies, people and capital continuously — with real depth in Bolivia, Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, Argentina, Chile and beyond — so you get there before the round does.
